Market Morning Brief 1.0.0 — Initial release.

- Delivers daily prediction market intelligence in plain text for morning and evening.
- Includes Kalshi portfolio summary, Polymarket volume insights, and crypto prices.
- Unlocks extra sections (Kalshalyst edges, Arbiter divergences, Xpulse signals) if paired with other skills.
- Resilient design: each section degrades gracefully if data is missing; never interrupts the briefing.
- Output is optimized for ultra-fast scanning (<30 seconds) and compatibility with any messaging platform.
